threads.title: The Edge (autogenerated ↔ composed)
threads.summary: The named finish line (Palle, 2026-07-13): the right edge between what the generators produce and what the author composes. Desktop walks already show the gap — the world 'is not really there' — so the missing piece is not observation but a look-contract: rulings on the look, judged in language over captures, compiled back into the generators (staging DNA, rule box, gallery genomes). The craft coefficient measured this residue for ordering; the spatial equivalent has no RULINGS file yet. If the look of the organization lands, the project tips over the edge — and proves language + observation can do the whole work.

threads.title: Biome Grid (the living layer)
threads.summary: Palle, 2026-07-16: the biome becomes part of the grid — grid points activate algorithms that produce the biome as a living layer on the cells, with roles (seed/field/edge/halo/mute) and modifiers (density, tier, palette, clock). Completes the June consolidation plan (three populators -> one dispatcher) and gives soul maps a declared vacuum (mute). Design: doc/plans/biome_grid_redesign.md. CORE GRID: additive, gated, negative-tested. ADDENDUM: reactivity — cells declare on=<trigger>:<response> (catalyst modes, touch, dwell, tick); CA steps and claims expand layers at runtime via the existing mutator stack; declared vs runtime state kept honestly separate.

openItems.text: Step 1-2: layers.biome grammar in BiomePaintTokens + GridBiomeComponent (additive, gated); negative test — maps without the layer load byte-identically — DONE: BiomeGridTokens + GridBiomeComponent (+react pilot: seed/step/claim/mute); positive 6-cell stats exact on Biome_GridTest; negative PASS on Point_One

Reactivity runtime DONE 2026-07-19: play now CALLS react(). Catalyst: every CatalystProjectile impact fires react_at_world(pos, catalyst.<mode id>) (real MODES ids: chromatic/fractal/branching/...) via the biome_grid group (joined only when a layer is declared - group-miss no-op elsewhere); the biome brush fires catalyst.biome_brush once per cell per stroke. Clock: touch (camera cell-entry, ProximityLOD proxy) / dwell (once per visit) / tick - _process enabled ONLY when a declared cell asks; _meta tick_seconds/dwell_seconds. Responses got teeth: seed now STAGES a newly-active unmuted cell (unmute/seed opens the vacuum and renders it); mutate.<channel> (DOT - colon is the token separator, parser would shear it) routes to GridMutatorBase family (color/visibility|hide/transform|rotate|lift/glyph/part) as advance_to_next_pattern(); unrouted channels counted + printed, never silent. Probe probe_biome_reactivity.gd 14/14 (typed-trigger negative, world mapping, claim staging, vacuum, declared-only clock, mutate real+unrouted); gate map Biome_ReactTest boots clock ON tick 3s / 5 reactive / 0 invalid. GOTCHA for probes: is_inside_tree() is FALSE during SceneTree _init - mutator scan climbs ancestors instead of get_tree().root.

Dispatcher routing DONE 2026-07-17: 3.b-3.e branches were already live (flower/fungus CA/tree DNA/creature); layers.biome seed+halo+claimed cells now route through BiomePaintDispatcher.spawn_cell with the honesty guard, real structure heights via deposit world_pos, mineral/water/meta stay pilot markers. Verified headless: 4 substrate kingdoms rendered on Biome_GridTest, Point_One silent

Halo replaces the ring DONE 2026-07-17: halo cells spill per-cell wilderness outward (ground strip + kingdom ground-cover, deterministic, no collider, void stays void between bands); a map declaring halo cells data-gates ground_ring off (has_biome_halo in accrual ctx). A/B captured on biome_lab siblings Biome_HaloRing (ring, density 1.0) vs Biome_HaloTest (32 halo cells, 875 instances, ring retired). NOTE: the ring's walkable off-grid collider is NOT reproduced — halo is scenery only
Accrual compile-in tool: sequence defaults written as explicit biome rows (sibling-first)
Authoring: 4th paint mode in /template-maps (kingdom palette + roles); pattern editor biome codes

Perf gate DONE 2026-07-18: halo strips/cover/markers batch into one MultiMesh per (kind,kingdom,recipe) - O(kingdoms) nodes, not O(cells) (synthetic 20x14: 1995 instances 10 nodes; Biome_HaloTest: 911 instances 7 nodes); per-map budget via layers.biome._meta {budget_instances, visibility_range} (dict form {_meta,rows}), even-stride clamp honestly printed - negative test bites (kept 99 of 1995 under budget 100); visibility_range_end on every batch. NOT through ChunkManager, deliberately: ChunkManager is the unique-DNA organism LOD (explicitly cannot batch); halo cover is identical geometry - the MultiMesh case. Its discipline (bounded counts, culling, budget) applied natively. Probe: commons/testing/probe_biome_batching.gd; gate maps Biome_HaloTest (regression) + Biome_HaloBudget (dict form, clamp visible in capture). Per-cell RNG unchanged - geometry identical to the per-cell path. Runtime claims after flush spawn direct (counted late_spawns).

threads.title: Mycelium substrate (filaments beyond the CA)
threads.summary: Scoped 2026-07-19 out of the biome visual loop. fungus:ca (the MoldNetwork CA) hit its ceiling in the rule-search: it renders a spreading voxel NETWORK when gen-frozen, but fundamentally FILLS OR DIES — it cannot hold hair-thin branching filaments. True mycelium (hyphae thinning to their tips, an irregular ground web) needs a CURVE renderer. Plan: a new fungus algo `fungus:mycelium:seed` that generates branching paths (prototype L-system turtle, target space-colonization toward ground attractors) and renders each hypha as a tapering MorphoSweep tube, batched (biome-6). REUSE: morpho_sweep.gd (the tube-along-curve = a hypha), Turtle/tree_walker (branching), grammar_seed (the walk); fungus_morphology.gd = MUSHROOMS (fruiting body), NOT the web — optional dressing at dense nodes. Plugs into biome_paint_dispatcher._spawn_fungus as an algo branch — `ca` unchanged (additive), `mycelium` new. Design: doc/plans/mycelium_substrate.md.

openItems.text: Filament render spike: one L-system branch string -> MorphoSweep tapering tubes -> capture on a probe map. Proves the pipeline (morpho_sweep + Turtle/tree_walker already exist). — DONE 2026-07-19: mycelium_spike.gd (L-system F->FF[+F][-F][&F], 4 iters, 3D turtle) + MorphoSweep.sweep(profile_circle(6), path_line, radius_taper by depth) per hypha + glowing spore tips. Captured (--mode=artifact): a real branching filament web, thick strands tapering to thin tips (the taper a voxel grid can't do). Pipeline PROVEN. Notes for later: per-segment MeshInstances (batch=milestone 3); some vertical spread (flatten=milestone 5); regular L-system branching (space-colonization irregularity=milestone 2).

Space-colonization generator: attractors scattered on a ground disc, grow-to-attractor with attractor-kill, emergent branching web; capture; compare to the L-system spike and pick the generator (space colonization = the organic irregular look; L-system = the fast scaffold). — DONE 2026-07-21: mycelium_colony.gd (attractors on a ground disc, grow-to-attractor with attractor-kill, spatial hash so 900 attractors / 2600 nodes run in the same 12s as the naive 260/900). RULING: space colonization is the generator; the L-system spike stays the scaffold — it branches on schedule, the colony branches because local food runs out. Two findings: thickness must come from SUBTREE WEIGHT (flow toward the seed), not branch depth; the spatial hash is load-bearing, not an optimisation. GAP OPENED: the colony is a TREE — real mycelium anastomoses (hyphae fuse into loops) and space colonization cannot make a cycle; needs a fusion pass (folded into milestone 5).
Batch the tube segments into MultiMesh under the biome-6 per-map budget; O(kingdoms) nodes + a negative budget-clamp test (a colony is hundreds of segments — batching is mandatory).

Wire into biome_paint_dispatcher._spawn_fungus as the `fungus:mycelium` algo branch; additive negative test (fungus:ca maps byte-identical); reuse t=/d=/gen= mods (tier->radius, density->attractor count, gen->iterations) + per-cell deterministic seed & jitter.

Tune the mycelial read at biome scale: min radius so filaments survive VR distance, emission for the bioluminescent look, per-cell variation; before/after vs the CA network on Biome_VisualBench (THE EDGE: rulings over captures, language+desktop observation). PLUS anastomosis: fuse tips that pass within a radius so the mat reads as a web, not a starburst, and run the thickness solver on a graph rather than a tree (opened by milestone 2's ruling).

Ruling: does fungus:mycelium become the default fungus look, or ship both (ca=voxel network, mycelium=filaments) as an authoring choice? Optional fruiting bodies (fungus_morphology mushrooms) at dense nodes.
